findings.text: Notification subscription selection uses one contiguous numeric interval that starts at thirty two thousand seven hundred sixty eight for data input output and proceeds through successive purposes for association and address and delivery and control occurrences until the send failed occurrence which also marks the interval maximum.
Authentication notification is reachable as SCTP_AUTHENTICATION_EVENT and additionally under an indication spelling that equals that event value so either selects the same numeric value.

Early error causes distinguish threshold failure as SCTP_FAILED_THRESHOLD and sack reception as SCTP_RECEIVED_SACK and heartbeat success as SCTP_HEARTBEAT_SUCCESS with successive small numbers from zero.

Later error causes distinguish user request response as SCTP_RESPONSE_TO_USER_REQ and internal failure as SCTP_INTERNAL_ERROR and shutdown guard expiry as SCTP_SHUTDOWN_GUARD_EXPIRES and faulty peer as SCTP_PEER_FAULTY continuing the same numeric progression.

Retransmission timeout configuration carries an association handle named srto_assoc_id followed by an initial value named srto_initial and then a maximum named srto_max and finally a minimum named srto_min where the handle uses an association type and each timeout uses a thirty two bit unsigned type.

Heartbeat control distinguishes enable as SPP_HB_ENABLE and disable as SPP_HB_DISABLE and their combination as SPP_HB and immediate demand as SPP_HB_DEMAND using low order bits.

Path control distinguishes MTU discovery enable as SPP_PMTUD_ENABLE and disable as SPP_PMTUD_DISABLE and their combination as SPP_PMTUD alongside sack delay enable as SPP_SACKDELAY_ENABLE and disable as SPP_SACKDELAY_DISABLE and their combination as SPP_SACKDELAY.
Additional path options distinguish zero heartbeat delay as SPP_HB_TIME_IS_ZERO and IPv6 flow label handling as SPP_IPV6_FLOWLABEL and DSCP handling as SPP_DSCP in higher bits.

Hash algorithm list carries a thirty two bit count named shmac_num_idents followed by a flexible trailing array of sixteen bit identifiers named shmac_idents where the count is also reachable under an alternate spelling that abbreviates number.

First tuning block carries association sack_assoc_id with delay sack_delay and frequency sack_freq while second generic block carries association assoc_id with value assoc_value while third stream block carries association assoc_id with identifier stream_id and value stream_value using sixteen bit stream fields.

Transport reachability progresses among inactive and potentially failed and active and unconfirmed with unknown represented by sixty five thousand five hundred thirty five where potentially failed is reachable under two spellings with the longer spelling aliasing the short form.
Reachability values are encoded as SCTP_INACTIVE and SCTP_PF and SCTP_ACTIVE and SCTP_UNCONFIRMED and SCTP_UNKNOWN with the last using all sixteen bits set.

Association lifecycle begins empty as SCTP_EMPTY and then closed as SCTP_CLOSED and then cookie wait as SCTP_COOKIE_WAIT and then cookie echoed as SCTP_COOKIE_ECHOED and then established as SCTP_ESTABLISHED using values zero through four in order.

Shutdown progression continues pending as SCTP_SHUTDOWN_PENDING and then sent as SCTP_SHUTDOWN_SENT and then received as SCTP_SHUTDOWN_RECEIVED and then acknowledgement sent as SCTP_SHUTDOWN_ACK_SENT using values five through eight in order.
